scope: Fresh full-competition saved-model replay of all six legacy Round3 components used by the actual Round5 submission. No fitting, no predictions exported, no production edits. Complements the fresh all-28-Round5-model replay and exact cached blend reconstruction in audit_20261017_pipeline.json.
processes: Six sequential separate Python processes, one saved model loaded at a time. Tree and neural libraries isolated by process.
method: Read current config and saved model, build current features from supplied test inputs in template order in 32-case batches, apply current economic rescaling and exact saved generator categories; use stored neural mean/std without refitting and eval mode. Reconstruct case/output order with prediction_frame and compare every saved probability.
serialization_note: All XGBoost and Transformer values agree after float32 round-trip; the <=2.981e-8 float64 differences are consistent with float32 CSV decimal serialization. Pooled LightGBM matches the parsed float64 cache exactly.
limitations: Inference/cache reproducibility does not establish clean validation, generalization, optimization adequacy, or deterministic retraining. It rules out a current saved-model-to-competition-cache mismatch at native model precision.
replay_script_source:
import os
for k in ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS','NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS']:
 os.environ[k]='1'
import sys,time,json,hashlib,gc,warnings
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'src'))
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.special import expit
from features import ROOT,HOURS,build_features,load_data,prediction_frame
from tree_preprocessing import rescale_tree_features
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore',category=pd.errors.PerformanceWarning)
name=sys.argv[1]
started=time.monotonic()
config_path=ROOT/'configs'/f'{name}.json'; report_path=ROOT/'reports'/f'{name}_run.json'
config=json.loads(config_path.read_text()); run=json.loads(report_path.read_text())
kind='neural' if config.get('model_type')=='transformer' else 'lgb' if name=='goal_submission_lightgbm_rescaled' else 'xgb'
model_path=ROOT/'models'/(f'{name}.pt' if kind=='neural' else f'lightgbm_{name}.txt' if kind=='lgb' else f'{name}.ubj' if config.get('target_generator') else f'xgboost_{name}.ubj')
cache_path=ROOT/'data/processed'/f'{name}_predictions.csv'
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
 return h.hexdigest()
protected={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in [config_path,report_path,model_path,cache_path]}
options={k:config.get(k,False) for k in ['use_extended','use_system_context','use_topology','use_price_context','use_water_context','use_economic_context','use_river_context','use_inflow_profiles','use_hydraulic_context','use_water_budget','use_temporal_ranks','use_favourable_periods']}
train,columns,generators,inputs,topology=load_data(use_extended=options['use_extended'])
template=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'data/raw/sample_submission.csv',usecols=['Run No'])
mapping=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'data/raw/prediction_mapping.csv')
cases=mapping.set_index('Run No').loc[template['Run No']].reset_index();cases['starttime']=pd.to_datetime(cases.starttime,utc=True)
assert not train['Run No'].isin(cases['Run No']).any()
cache=pd.read_csv(cache_path,float_precision='round_trip');assert cache['Run No'].equals(cases['Run No'])
output_generators=[config['target_generator']] if config.get('target_generator') else generators
output_columns=[c for c in columns if any(c.startswith('result_committed_'+g+'_t') for g in output_generators)]
assert cache.columns.tolist()==['Run No',*output_columns]
if kind=='neural':
 import torch
 from temporal_cnn import sequence_features,predict
 from weekly_transformer import WeeklyTransformer
 torch.set_num_threads(1);torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
 checkpoint=torch.load(model_path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 assert checkpoint['config']==config
 assert checkpoint['generators']==generators
 model=WeeklyTransformer(len(checkpoint['feature_names']),len(output_generators),**config['model'])
 model.load_state_dict(checkpoint['state_dict'],strict=True);model.eval()
 mean=checkpoint['mean'].numpy();std=checkpoint['std'].numpy()
 assert np.isfinite(mean).all() and np.isfinite(std).all() and (std>0).all()
 names=checkpoint['feature_names']
else:
 if kind=='xgb':
  import xgboost as xgb
  model=xgb.XGBClassifier(n_jobs=1,enable_categorical=True);model.load_model(model_path);model.set_params(n_jobs=1);names=model.get_booster().feature_names
 else:
  import lightgbm as lgb
  model=lgb.Booster(model_file=str(model_path),params={'num_threads':1});names=model.feature_name()
 expected=run.get('features',run.get('feature_names'))
 if expected: assert expected==names
maximum=0.;total=0;exact=True;float32exact=True;batch_rows=[]
for start in range(0,len(cases),32):
 batch=cases.iloc[start:start+32].reset_index(drop=True)
 if kind=='neural':
  x,actualnames=sequence_features(batch,generators,inputs,topology,use_economic_rescaling=config.get('use_economic_rescaling',False),use_weekly_normalization=config.get('use_weekly_normalization',False),**options)
  assert actualnames==names
  values=predict(model,torch.from_numpy((x-mean)/std),torch.device('cpu'),config['batch_size'])
  replay=prediction_frame(values.transpose(1,0,2).ravel(),batch,output_columns,output_generators)[output_columns].to_numpy()
 else:
  x=build_features(batch,output_generators,inputs,topology,**options)
  if config.get('use_economic_rescaling',False):x=rescale_tree_features(x)
  assert x.columns.tolist()==names
  if kind=='xgb':
   x['generator_id']=pd.Categorical(x['generator_id'],categories=range(len(output_generators)))
   values=model.predict_proba(x)[:,1]
  else:values=expit(model.predict(x,raw_score=True,num_threads=1))
  replay=prediction_frame(values,batch,output_columns,output_generators)[output_columns].to_numpy()
 expected=cache.iloc[start:start+len(batch)][output_columns].to_numpy()
 difference=float(np.max(np.abs(replay-expected)));maximum=max(maximum,difference);exact &= bool(np.array_equal(replay,expected));float32exact &= bool(np.array_equal(replay.astype(np.float32),expected.astype(np.float32)))
 assert np.isfinite(replay).all() and ((replay>=0)&(replay<=1)).all()
 total+=replay.size
 if start in (0,352,704):print(name,'cases',start+len(batch),'maxdiff',maximum,'elapsed',time.monotonic()-started,flush=True)
 del x,values,replay,expected
 tolerance=2e-6 if kind=='neural' else 1e-7
 assert difference<tolerance,(name,start,difference,tolerance)
assert protected=={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in [config_path,report_path,model_path,cache_path]}
result={'component':name,'kind':kind,'status':'passed','cases':len(cases),'outputs_per_case':len(output_columns),'verified_probabilities':total,'max_absolute_difference':maximum,'bitwise_equal_float64_csv':exact,'float32_equal':float32exact,'absolute_tolerance':tolerance,'relative_tolerance':0,'cpu_threads':1,'feature_count':len(names),'first_date':str(cases.starttime.min()),'last_date':str(cases.starttime.max()),'test_year_counts':{str(k):int(v) for k,v in cases.starttime.dt.year.value_counts().items()},'saved_scaler_no_refit':kind=='neural','dropout_disabled_eval_mode':kind=='neural','config_run_model_feature_order_checked':True,'cache_row_column_order_checked':True,'input_sha256':protected,'input_hashes_unchanged':True,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'batch_size':32}
with Path(f'/tmp/audit_20261017_legacy_{name}.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
